text: The original async onSendOpenPGP returns prepareSendMsg directly inside try, so its catch does not observe a later rejected preparation promise. The immediate follow-up awaits that helper in a small caller try with pgpSuccess initially false. Both false and rejection then call resetUpdatedFields and stop the send. That rollback removes an attached own key and restores the original subject when available; it is not generic cleanup for every send failure. Accepted0b93 instead awaits prepareSendMsg inside the helper catch and returns false there, so the caller no longer needs the temporary extra catch. Preserve these source phases when maintaining this path. The helper JSDoc says boolean although the async API resolves to a Boolean. No rejection/rollback test was added or run in the follow-up.
title: Catch OpenPGP preparation rejection at the boundary that owns rollback
